title: Cái này có đậu phộng không?
pronunciation: Cai nay co dau phong khong
summary: For checking a dish, sauce, topping, or dessert for peanuts before you eat or order.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Point to the exact dish or sauce. This question needs the item in view.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Ask before eating, then wait for a clear yes, no, or safer recommendation.

phrases.vietnamese: Cái này có đậu phộng không?
phrases.pronunciation: Cai nay co dau phong khong

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Cái này means this item; có asks has; đậu phộng means peanuts; không turns it into a yes/no question.

breakdown.vietnamese: Cái này có đậu phộng không?

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at stalls, restaurants, cafes, dessert counters, and markets when toppings or sauces are not obvious.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Peanuts can appear as garnish, sauce, or crushed topping. If peanuts are dangerous for you, follow with the allergy card.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Move to fish-sauce, egg-or-peanuts, vegetarian, or peanut-allergy cards if the answer needs more safety detail.
